evidence.activity: Self-serve, product-led onboarding of mostly smaller companies that have no existing travel and expense system
evidence.quote: In fact, since launching our new self-serve offering in March 2022, thousands of customers have joined our platform through our website, with minimal sales touchpoints.

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: small-business customers served by general T&E software, with no specific service aimed at barriers to starting or growing a business

creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers a travel, payments and expense platform with no creative activity, and 'design', 'content' and 'content marketing' appear only in trap senses.

community.reason: Level 1 on general language only ('invested substantial time and resources in building our team'), and coverage is insufficient under condition 2 because the Human Capital section discusses no training, development or community activity, so the relevant discussion is well under about 150 words.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 0 because the filing shows no qualifying activity (international operations, localized support and a 'diverse' customer base don't count), and coverage is insufficient under condition 2 because the Human Capital section contains essentially no discussion of inclusion, accessibility or employee networks, well under about 150 words.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: the company serves small and medium-sized businesses through a self-serve T&E product, but it describes no specific program or tool aimed at barriers to starting or growing a business.

ai.notes: Both Community and Cross-cultural are marked insufficient, so this company should get the automated second look using a sustainability report from navan.com. The ~3,700-employee Human Capital section covers only headcount, union status and talent retention. The following terms were excluded as traps: 'foundation' in Item 7 means platform foundation; 'train' refers to AI virtual-agent training; customer-success 'education' and 'in-product customer education' are adoption marketing; 'design' refers to UI and product design; 'content' means supplier fare and seat content and content marketing; 'diverse' describes the customer base and revenue geography; acquisitions in Germany, India and Italy and multi-currency services are international operations only. Smaller unmanaged customers in the product-led growth strategy are the same activity as E1 and are counted once.
